terbaru.judul: Leveraged positions on decentralized lending platforms
terbaru.pelajaran: We develop a mathematical framework to optimize leveraged staking ("loopy") strategies in Decentralized Finance (DeFi), in which a staked asset is supplied as collateral, the underlying is borrowed and re-staked, and the loop can be repeated across multiple lending markets.

terbaru.judul: ASAS-BridgeAMM: Trust-Minimized Cross-Chain Bridge AMM with Failure Containment
terbaru.pelajaran: We present ASAS-BridgeAMM, a bridge-coupled automated market maker that introduces Contained Degradation: a formally specified operational state where the system gracefully degrades functionality in response to adversarial signals.

terbaru.judul: Automated Liquidity: Market Impact, Cycles, and De-pegging Risk
terbaru.pelajaran: Three traits of decentralized finance are studied.

terbaru.judul: Systemic Risk in DeFi: A Network-Based Fragility Analysis of TVL Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: Overall, this study provides a unified quantitative framework for ecosystem-level analysis and continuous monitoring of systemic risk in DeFi.

terbaru.judul: A Blessing in Disguise? DeFi Exploits and Short-Horizon Responses in U.S. Commercial Paper Spreads
terbaru.pelajaran: Do vulnerabilities in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) destabilize traditional short-term funding markets?

terbaru.judul: SSR: Safeguarding Staking Rewards by Defining and Detecting Logical Defects in DeFi Staking
terbaru.pelajaran: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) staking is one of the most prominent applications within the DeFi ecosystem, where DeFi projects enable users to stake tokens on the platform and reward participants with additional tokens.

terbaru.judul: Institutional Backing and Crypto Volatility: A Hybrid Framework for DeFi Stabilization
terbaru.pelajaran: This study investigates whether HyFi-like cryptocurrencies, those backed by institutions, exhibit lower price risk than fully decentralized counterparts.

terbaru.judul: A Unified Framework and Comparative Study of Decentralized Finance Derivatives Protocols
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper systematically analyzes DeFi derivatives protocols, categorized into perpetuals, options, and synthetics, with the aim of comparing their instrument structures, protocol mechanisms, operational dynamics, and economic agents.

terbaru.judul: Design of a Decentralized Fixed-Income Lending Automated Market Maker Protocol Supporting Arbitrary Maturities
terbaru.pelajaran: Building upon the BondMM protocol, this paper argues that its mathematical invariants are sufficiently elegant to be generalized to arbitrary maturities.

terbaru.judul: Formal State-Machine Models for Uniswap v3 Concentrated-Liquidity AMMs: Priced Timed Automata, Finite-State Transducers, and Provable Rounding Bounds
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper we propose a formal modeling approach for Uniswap v3-style CLAMMs using (i) networks of priced timed automata (PTA), and (ii) finite-state transducers (FST) over discrete ticks.
